items.title: Ed Soph interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 9, 2024
items.q: He’s definitely on top of the beat.

ctx.x: I saw Louis Hayes in New York with this group. And I could not believe that by the time this song was going to be done that it hadn’t sped up by 20 beats per minute or something. Because he was so aggressive and — I don’t know if I even said he’s on top of the beat, I just felt like —
He’s definitely on top of the beat.
